avis.texte: So, I have been on the hunt for a sunscreen I will put on regularly that is comfortable to wear. I decided to try this one and see how it went. Well, I LOVE the mattifying ability of the spf but it does not dry! It will not absorb into the skin, I've experimented with trying different amounts and applying in layers. It tends to slide around the skin all day. The texture is strange, but other than that, I just wish it would absorb. No sensitivity, no burns with it thus far. So, if you don't mind your sunscreen just sitting on your skin, I would go for it. Murad makes an incredible mattifying sunscreen..lacks that weird texture and absorbs very nicely. Still on the spf hunt lol..

Using the proper amount for protection, this NEVER fully dries down! I used powder foundation over and it was still like ... goopy? all day long. I could FEEL it. Returning. Get the WishCare Oil Balance SPF instead!

This stuff feels weird when applied on the skin. I also don't notice any type of mattifying from wearing it. I had high hopes for this as I love the idea of a matte sunscreen for my face. I returned this because it fell short of my expectations.

Ive used this sunscreen for nearly 1 mo. I bought 2--used 1 & returned the other. Unfortunately, this sunscreen does not provide a matte finish. The finish is a velvet finish, which is nice, but does not help control oil in t-zone. which is what I need. Also, I would agree with another reviewer that it is not for oily, acne-prone skin. My recommendation would depend on a person's skin.

avis.titre: Maybe it helped prevent sunburn a bit...
avis.texte: I typically enjoy ANUA. I still got sunburn and redness after using a good amount on my face and neck. Also its does not absorb much. Its got a soft, velvety, clear finish but stuck to my hair which made my glasses messy. I was only in direct sunlight for 10min.

I have been told by a derm that I have dehydrated skin, therefore my skin produces extra amounts of oil. Not sure what to believe the derm or what I see in the mirror, but I bought the sunscreen to help with the issue of the appearing oily. Also I dont use makeup just my eyes. It is superlight weight which I love and can apply quickly and gel type textures have always worked well with my skin. Buuuut after a while the texture was no longer a gel it became a very watery liquid. I took care of my product as far as storing it in cool low temperatures so i dont know what happened. Maybe it got too hot while i showered. I really love the product besides that. Did anyone else have this issue with it becoming runny? PLS let me know. It will help me decide if I need to buy this again.

I've been looking for a good sunscreen for my face/neck just for everyday use, and I saw this one was getting decent reviews so I figured I'd give it a try. This is the first one I've come across that's ACTUALLY a matte finish! ZERO white cast, and also makes pores appear smaller (nothing drastic but noticeable). I have combo/oily skin and I usually breakout on my forehead and chin, but this hasn't caused any reaction either. It also dries down a bit after about 10 minutes and has a satin-like feel on the skin, not sticky. The key is just not to over-apply, a little goes a long way! Doesn't make me look too shiny either which is something that bugs me. AND I actually used it as a primer for my makeup and it worked so well! No pilling, no weird smudging while I was applying makeup, and it lasted all day and made my makeup stay intact. Honestly I'm gonna be repurchasing because this is such a great product. **It's not for swimming! Just outdoor/indoor use just FYI.
Coming from a girl who is oily 24/7, this is a great product!!! All other sunscreens leave me oily and cause irritation to my eyes. I will repurchase this!

I've been trying so many sunscreens but they always leave me shiny or my makeup starts peeling. This one left me matte in a really humid 4th of July in TX, I didn't even use powder! I love it so much.
I baught this and my skin was initially mostly clear however after one use by the end of the day i had an acne flare up. Ended up throwing it out

The texture is similar to the smashbox blurring primer. The smell is minimal and it does not burn my eyes! I wear it under makeup in this order: moisturizer, sunscreen, Danessa primer, then makeup. The color is slight but blurs into your face.

I always struggle finding sunscreens that dont end up making me look shiny or that sit well under make up without pilling. This one has worked great for me so far! It leaves a smooth matte finish on my skin and has sat nicely under make up.

I have been using the regular version of this sunblock from Anua and I'm already a fan, but I decided to try the matte version—and I love it. It's definitely mattifying without feeling heavy or drying. This one did not disappoint at all. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for something to wear under makeup. If you prefer more of a glowy finish, I'd suggest going with the original formula. I'll definitely continue purchasing both—I absolutely love their products.

I used to use Anua "zero cast" and love it, but I wanted something completely matte for my oily skin. I was a little bit skeptical at the beginning because the consistency is like vaseline, but the product is amazing.
Best invisible sunscreen I've tried so far! Can't tell I have any on. Wish it were a bigger tube.

avis.titre: Perfect for acne prone, sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have tried so many sunscreens for my oily/combination, acne prone skin, it's frustrating trying to find ones thst work. This is the first everday, matte sunscreen I have used that has not immediately broken me out or irritated my skin or eyes ( I have super sensitive eyes, the ingredient phenoxyethanol irritates my eyes but im happy this product doesn't have this ingredient!)

avis.titre: Nice velvety matte finish but not acne safe
avis.texte: After testing this product for a little over a month, I have concluded that it is the culprit of my breakouts and skin colored bumps. As soon as I stopped usage my skin calmed down. Nevertheless, can't say I don't love the satin matte finish once freshly applied. My face still got oily throughout the day but to be fair it could also be the makeup. As for the primer aspect I would recommend using a moisturizer prior because it can cling to dry patches and it is not hydrating. In essence, would not recommend this product to a friend if they have acne prone skin.

I'm 30 years old with very fair and mostly really dry skin, but I've always hated wearing sunscreen because it tends to feel so thick and heavy and dirty and stings my eyes. However, everyone says sunscreen is important so I decided to look for something that would suit my needs, and I went ahead and tried this one. I'm very happy with this sunscreen so far. It looks like I'm not wearing any at all, and it feels so light after applying a generous amount. It's not bothering my eyes either. I've tried other matte sunscreens before and they often feel extremely drying on my already super dry skin, but this one feels really smooth. It doesn't make my facial expressions feel rough and terrible like other sunscreens do, if you know what I mean lol. Even though my skin requires lots of moisturizing, I still cannot stand heavily greasy sunscreens either. This one is not greasy at all and just feels like the perfect balance for me. I'm definitely gonna buy this again in the future. I've added some photos so you can see how it looks, I'm only wearing the sunscreen and some mascara.

avis.titre: Blurs skin flaws but does NOT help makeup last longer
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product. It claims to be invisible, matte, blurring, and smoothing - and it is. Where it falls short, however, is as a makeup primer - sadly, instead of making my makeup last longer, it shortens the life of my makeup, and my makeup breaks up on top of this product. I'm much better off not wearing any primer at all, even if I try to give the product time to set. It doesn't feel like it really sets down and feels slippery throughout the day. I really want my SPF to be compatible with my makeup, so I will be returning. If you want something that feels cosmetically elegant and blurs pores and you don't plan to wear any makeup over top of it, this would probably work for you.

So glad I tried this. I was searching for a matte sunscreen after my favorite one changed the formula. It's very lightweight and it does leave a matte finish. And this is coming from a very oily girl.

I have oily skin and this sunscreen is perfect! It leaves my skin looking and feeling matte and soft for the whole day! It is also comedonal acne safe which is a big plus! I can also wear moisturizer without my skin getting oily!

I have mature, sensitive, oily skin. The sunscreen I have used in the past has changed their formula recently. The new formula is just a greasy mess on my face. I have been on the hunt for a new sunscreen. I went into Ulta and staff recommended this. It has been amazing and works very well under makeup. Will be buying again.

I am in LOVE with this product. I have oily skin and this product helps me control my oil without giving me a dull appearance. My glow from my other skincare products still shines through this product which I love!! This product also makes my pores less noticeable & it makes my skin really soft and smooth. I don't wear foundation, so I really appreciate how this product makes my skin look. PLEASE DO NOT DISCONTINUE THIS PRODUCT. I need it😭💕
